title: NYC Taxi - Streaming Pipeline
description: Kafka cluster health, consumer lag, pipeline throughput and sliding-window results.

panels.title: Min in-sync replicas
panels.description: Lowest ISR size across partitions. min.insync.replicas=2, so 1 blocks acks=all producers.

panels.title: Scrape targets
panels.description: Prometheus scrape health of every component.

panels.title: Topic write rate by partition (msg/s)
panels.description: Log-end offset growth per partition: shows how evenly the zone key spreads load.

panels.title: Consumer group lag by partition (committed offsets)
panels.description: From kafka-exporter: log-end offset minus the group's committed offset.

panels.title: DB backpressure
panels.description: 1 while the processor is retrying TimescaleDB writes (Kafka buffers meanwhile).

panels.title: Lag seen by each processor instance
panels.description: Log-end offset minus the in-memory position (refreshed every 10 s).

panels.title: Processed events by outcome (events/s)
panels.description: inserted = new & on time; late = stored raw but past the watermark; duplicate = redelivery absorbed by the idempotent sink; invalid = sent to DLQ.

panels.title: End-to-end latency (producer -> DB commit)
panels.description: Includes the producer's deliberate hold-back of out-of-order events.

panels.title: Watermark (event time)
panels.description: Windows ending before this instant are final. Event times are 2023 (replayed data).

panels.title: Latest sliding windows (15 min window, 5 min slide) by pickup borough

targets.rawSql:
SELECT window_start AS "Window start",
       window_end   AS "Window end",
       pu_borough   AS "Borough",
       trip_count   AS "Trips",
       total_revenue AS "Revenue",
       fare_per_mile AS "Fare / mile",
       tip_pct_of_fare AS "Tip % of fare",
       CASE WHEN is_final THEN 'final' ELSE 'open' END AS "State",
       update_count AS "Updates"
FROM v_trip_window_metrics
WHERE window_end > (SELECT max(window_end) FROM trip_window_agg) - INTERVAL '30 minutes'
ORDER BY window_end DESC, trip_count DESC

SELECT to_char(window_end, 'MM-DD HH24:MI') AS "Window end",
       trip_count AS "Trips"
FROM (
    SELECT window_end, trip_count
    FROM trip_window_agg
    WHERE pu_borough = 'ALL'
    ORDER BY window_end DESC
    LIMIT 24
) latest
ORDER BY 1

SELECT count(*) AS "Raw events stored",
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE is_late) AS "Late events stored",
       count(DISTINCT kafka_partition) AS "Partitions seen"
FROM trip_events_raw
